trends.name: Iran War Escalation & Oil Shock
trends.summary: Trump signals imminent military escalation against Iran with 'decisive, overwhelming victory' rhetoric, contradicting earlier market expectations of de-escalation. Brent crude surges nearly 6%, up 70% from Dec 2025 lows, creating immediate energy inflation risk across supply chains. Iranian sources deny ceasefire talks, heightening geopolitical uncertainty and volatility in Asian/U.S. equities.

trends.name: Energy Infrastructure Damage & Supply Risk
trends.summary: Critical U.S. energy infrastructure targeted: largest gasoline pipeline damaged in Georgia, Valero refinery hit, Abu Dhabi facilities damaged. These cascading supply disruptions compound oil price shocks and threaten refining capacity, creating downstream impacts on fuel costs and transportation/logistics sectors.

trends.name: AI Chip & Data Storage Bottleneck
trends.summary: Western Digital identifies critical AI inference storage constraint limiting AI deployment scaling. Combined with reports of Huawei's cloud computing revenue collapse due to U.S. tech dominance, the AI infrastructure narrative shifts from compute to storage/supply chain vulnerabilities, impacting semiconductor and cloud stocks.

trends.name: Unexpected Market Recovery & Recession Odds Collapse
trends.summary: Recession probability drops to 26% from March highs despite Iran war escalation, signaling investor conviction in Fed's ability to absorb energy shocks. Bitcoin below $67k and stock futures hit session lows suggest volatility continues, but macro fear trade pricing appears overdone relative to fundamental resilience.

trends.name: Consumer Demand Resilience & Retail Strength
trends.summary: February retail sales beat expectations at +0.6%, contradicting consumer weakness narrative. Combined with Disney/Calvin Klein demand signals and strong ADP payroll expectations, consumer fundamentals remain intact despite inflationary oil shock and high gas prices creating psychological headwinds.

trends.name: Oil Price Pass-Through & Inflation Risk
trends.summary: ISM manufacturing data flags steel, aluminum, and petroleum-based product cost pressures from Middle East conflict. Oil's 70% rally since Dec creates real inflation risk; South Korean inflation rising despite government controls. March ISM data doesn't fully capture oil's explosive move, suggesting Q2 earnings face margin compression from energy cost pass-through.

trends.name: Trump Military/Geopolitical Policy Shifts
trends.summary: Noem's Latin America security doctrine visit and Trump's Iran escalation signal aggressive military foreign policy repositioning. China tests 7-ton cargo drones for recon ops in response. These geopolitical shifts reshape defense spending, trade risk, and regional stability narratives affecting emerging markets and commodity exposure.

trends.name: Tech Mega-Cap Earnings & Execution Risk
trends.summary: Intel rallies on turnaround signals; Microsoft's AI reset creates bargain entry; Broadcom's moat holds firm amid semiconductor cycle. However, Oracle's 30,000 layoffs signal cost-cutting amid uncertain AI ROI. Tech earnings season will reveal which firms can monetize AI versus absorb infrastructure costs.

trends.name: EV Demand Paradox & Auto Industry Pivot
trends.summary: Iran war escalation paradoxically boosts EV demand as consumers flee combustion engines on fuel cost fears, yet auto giants simultaneously pivot back to ICE vehicles. Tesla delivery update imminent amid mixed signals. This sector tension creates stock-picking volatility and challenges long-term EV thesis.

trends.name: Storage/Real Estate Credit Stress & REIT Yields
trends.summary: Starwood Property Trust offers discounted yields with contained credit risk in rising rate environment. Data center REITs benefit from AI infrastructure demand, but office/retail segments face headwinds. Dividend yield stories (6 raises including 10%+ hike) attract income investors amid market volatility.

trends.name: Financial Sector Valuation Disconnect
trends.summary: LendingClub mispriced on macro fear despite sound fundamentals; Munich Re expects 2026 slump from new strategic focus. Credit markets repricing Iran war risk, but selective opportunities exist in names with strong underwriting. Fed's ability to absorb inflation shock keeps rates/spreads stable.

trends.name: Emerging Market Contagion & China Policy Shift
trends.summary: Indian equities hit hard with 'worst might not be over' warnings; Asia-Pacific reverses gains on Iran escalation. China's central bank withdraws cash from system for first time in year, signaling cautious posture amid higher oil costs. Capital flows from emerging to developed markets as geopolitical risk spikes.
